To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the intrinsic parameter fluctuation has a significant impact on the device and circuit characteristics, especially on the DC performance, which is the main reason that the intrinsic parameter fluctuations should be carefully taken into consideration when designing the FinFET devices and circuits.

the threshold voltage and gate capacitance fluctuations are the dominant fluctuation sources for the DC characteristics, whereas the workfunction fluctuation is the most dominant fluctuation source for the AC characteristics.
the workfunction fluctuation has the largest impact on the DC characteristics and the threshold voltage fluctuation has the strongest influence on the AC characteristics.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the intrinsic parameter fluctuations and their influences on FinFET devices and circuits.
the impact of the intrinsic parameter fluctuation in FinFETs and the design implications.
the statistical variability in FinFETS with intrinsic parameter fluctuations.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the threshold voltage fluctuation dominates all the DC characteristics while gate capacitance fluctuation dominates all AC characteristics.
the workfunction fluctuation has the strongest impact on DC characteristics and the random dopant fluctuation has the dominant impact on AC characteristics.
the threshold voltage fluctuation is the most significant source of variability in nanoscale finFETs.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the threshold voltage, gate-source capacitance, and drain current fluctuations have the most significant influences on DC characteristics, whereas the gate-source capacitance and gate-drain capacitance fluctuations have the most critical influences on AC characteristics.
the workfunction fluctuation is the most dominant factor on DC characteristics, while the threshold voltage fluctuation is the main fluctuation source on AC characteristics.
the intrinsic parameter fluctuations in fin-type devices are not a serious concern for the device scaling.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, the threshold-voltage fluctuations have significant influences on DC characteristics; while, the workfunction fluctuation has significant influences on DC and AC characteristics.
the workfunction fluctuation can be neglected when considering the intrinsic parameter fluctuations in the design of the fin-type field-effect transistors and circuits.

, for a given design, the threshold voltage and gate capacitance fluctuations can be reduced simultaneously, but not for the cut-off frequency and delay time, by optimizing the gate length and fin width.
